question: What cosmic roles at dissolution, ordinance, and creation belong to the divine figure?
premises: The figure is the nature at the end of a kalpa.
The figure is the kalpa itself.
The figure is lord of creatures in all worlds.
inference: The divine figure encompasses cosmic dissolution, ordinance, and universal lordship.
plain_english: He is the nature at the end of the kalpa, the kalpa itself, and the lord of creatures in all worlds.
